final: WITH sex_averages AS (SELECT p.SEX AS sex, AVG(l.WBC / l.PLT) AS avg_wbc_per_plt, AVG(l.HGB / l.HCT) AS avg_hgb_per_hct FROM Laboratory AS l JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = l.ID GROUP BY p.SEX), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_wbc_per_plt) AS avg_wbc_per_plt FROM sex_averages) SELECT s.sex, s.avg_wbc_per_plt, s.avg_hgb_per_hct, s.avg_wbc_per_plt - o.avg_wbc_per_plt FROM sex_averages AS s JOIN overall AS o ON o.avg_wbc_per_plt IS NOT NULL
